profile.confirmDeactivate:
Deactivate this business location?
Data from its branches will no longer be included in the accounting books and declarations from now on. Existing data is not changed.
profile.deleteDesc: The tax settings of tax code {code} will be deleted. Sales data is not affected.

sectors.title: Business sectors & tax rates on revenue
sectors.name: Business sector
sectors.cannotRemoveDefault: The default business sector cannot be removed — choose another default first.
sectors.categoriesDesc: Product revenue is taxed by the sector of its category. Blank subcategories follow their parent; unassigned ones use the default sector.
sectors.noCategories: No product categories yet (create them in Settings → Products).
sectors.defaultTaxRate: Default tax rate for products without one
sectors.note: Products with tax rate KCT / KKKNT are not subject to VAT. Vaccines and medical services are usually VAT-exempt. Default rates follow the 2026 household-business tax rules — have your accountant confirm them.
